title: 第一章：今天开始营业 · 第3节：午后：第一批客人
description: 驿站完成首次营业。相聚的客人稳定了晶石的光，修复裂痕仍需寻找碎片。
source: 原创奇幻剧情与四道分段听力题，非考试原文。
audioLabel: 离线固定角色英文配音

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lu Chuan sets the vegetables on the kitchen table. Aelia takes the list and checks the accounts first.
lines.translation: 陆川把蔬菜放上厨房桌，艾莉娅接过清单，先核对了账目。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I took thirty copper coins and spent eighteen on ingredients. Twelve remain for tomorrow's supplies.
lines.translation: 带去三十枚铜币，食材花了十八枚。还有十二枚，够留作明天的采购钱。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Put those twelve aside first. We will count today's earnings after closing.
lines.translation: 先把这十二枚单独放好。今天挣的钱，打烊后再算。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Right. Writing 'innkeeper' beside my name will not make the budget grow.
lines.translation: 好的。预算不会因为我写了“老板”两个字就自己变多。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: The soup is hot. Keep the three dishes on the menu. Do not promise food we cannot prepare.
lines.translation: 汤已经热了。菜单还是三样，不接我们做不出来的菜。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The doorbell rings. A delivery worker brings in flour and eggs, then brushes dust from his sleeves.
lines.translation: 门口铃响，送货人抬进面粉和鸡蛋，拍了拍袖子上的尘土。

lines.speaker: 送货人
lines.text: Here are your supplies. I have another delivery soon. Could I have soup without eggs?
lines.translation: 货到了。我还要赶下一趟车，能不能来一碗汤，别放鸡蛋？

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Vegetable soup without eggs. Would you like bread to take away?
lines.translation: 蔬菜汤，不加鸡蛋。面包需要带走吗？

lines.speaker: 送货人
lines.text: Yes, two slices to take away. I will have the soup here. I only have fifteen minutes.
lines.translation: 对，两片面包带走。汤在这里喝，我只有一刻钟。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: I will pack the bread. Lu Chuan, give him the seat by the door. His cart is just outside.
lines.translation: 我来装面包。陆川，给他靠门的座位，车就在窗外。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Two slices in a bag, soup served hot. Our first order is also a memory test.
lines.translation: 两片面包装袋，汤趁热端上。原来第一笔订单，还考验记忆力。

lines.speaker: 送货人
lines.text: Listening is what matters. Last time, someone heard 'no eggs' as 'two more eggs'.
lines.translation: 听清楚就好。上次有人把“不要鸡蛋”听成了“再加两个”。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Before the worker leaves, two patrol guards enter. One helps the other into a chair.
lines.translation: 送货人离开前，两名巡逻守卫推门进来，其中一人扶着同伴坐下。

lines.speaker: 守卫
lines.text: Two portions of bread and one plate of eggs. Give my companion soup first. He missed his meal on patrol.
lines.translation: 两份面包，一份煎蛋。汤先给我的同伴，他巡逻时没顾上吃饭。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Understood, soup first. Have you come back from the north?
lines.translation: 明白，先上热汤。你们从北边回来？

lines.speaker: 守卫
lines.text: Only as far as the barrier outside the mine. The warning sign is still there, but unfamiliar tracks appeared nearby last night.
lines.translation: 只巡到矿道外的路障。木牌还在，可昨晚附近又出现了陌生脚印。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Something unusual near the entrance? Then travelers should avoid that shortcut.
lines.translation: 入口附近有异常？那就别让赶路的人抄近道。

lines.speaker: 守卫
lines.text: I have reported it to the officer in town. We have not identified what left the tracks yet.
lines.translation: 我已把消息交给镇里的值守官。我们还没有确认脚印是什么留下的。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Spoons clink and conversation fills the hall. A steady glow appears around the crystal behind the counter.
lines.translation: 大厅里响起碗勺与谈笑声，吧台后的晶石浮出一层稳定的微光。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Aelia, the crystal is brighter than this morning. Will more guests repair it completely?
lines.translation: 艾莉娅，晶石比早上亮了。是不是客人越多，它就能完全修好？

lines.speaker: 言契系统
lines.text: Gathering stabilizes the seal's energy. Fragments restore the crystal's structure. The crack remains.
lines.translation: 相聚稳定封印的能量，碎片修复晶石的结构。当前裂痕仍然存在。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Our guests give it energy to shine, but they cannot fill the missing piece. We need both.
lines.translation: 客人让它有力气发光，却不能替它补上缺口。两件事都要做。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Let us serve good soup today. We will decide about the mine when we know more.
lines.translation: 今天先把热汤做好。调查矿道的事，等知道更多再决定。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lu Chuan places the paid orders inside the ledger. The waystation's first day now has a record worth keeping.
lines.translation: 陆川将已结账的订单夹在账本里。驿站第一次营业，有了可以留下的记录。

questions.prompt: Why does Aelia ask Lu Chuan to set twelve coins aside?
questions.explanation: 三十枚减去十八枚，剩余十二枚留作次日采购，不提前花掉备用金。

questions.prompt: What does the delivery worker order?
options: Egg soup and bread to eat inside.
Soup without eggs and two slices of bread to take away.
questions.explanation: 送货人要不加鸡蛋的汤，在店里喝；两片面包带走。

questions.prompt: What is known about the tracks near the mine?
options: Their source has not been identified yet.
They were made by the two guards.
They prove that the road is safe.
questions.explanation: 守卫已报告陌生脚印，但没有确认来源；不能把线索当成定论。

questions.prompt: Why does the crystal still need fragments?
options: The soup is not hot enough.
The crystal needs a larger counter.
Gathering supplies energy but does not repair its structure.
questions.explanation: 客人相聚稳定能量，碎片修复结构，二者职责不同。

ending: 驿站完成首次营业。相聚的客人稳定了晶石的光，修复裂痕仍需寻找碎片。
